deploy-bot: Canary deploy STARTED for runtime-proxy service (prod-canary)
deploy-bot: tag=release/2026-03-20-rtp-v2.14.3 commit=8b3f2c1 artifacts://rtp/8b3f2c1
maya: adding context — this is the perf + latency fixes, no schema changes. Sampling at 2% for now. :rocket:
oliver: @maya can you confirm the smoke test set includes `proxy-smoke/basic` and `auth-integration`?
maya: yes included both
ci-bot: smoke tests passed: proxy-smoke/basic (ok), auth-integration (ok). artifacts verified.
obs-bot: initial telemetry (first 5m): p50=52ms p95=190ms error_rate=0.08% cpu=46% mem=61%
sanjay: seeing a small uptick in 500s from one AZ, digging in :mag:
obs-bot: sample logs from instance rtp-az3:
```
2026-03-20T14:08:17Z ERROR upstream timeout id=4f2a msg="connect timeout"
2026-03-20T14:08:19Z WARN upstream retry id=4f2a
```
oliver: rolling traffic to 5% in az3 only to isolate. `deploy-bot set-traffic runtime-proxy 5 --az=az3`
maya: good isolating step. @sanjay any rollback needed?
sanjay: no rollback, az3 appears to have transient network blips. error_rate reduced after cordon. monitoring 10m :eyes:
deploy-bot: Canary updated: traffic 2% -> 5% (az3), status=partial
obs-bot: 20m check: p50=50ms p95=185ms error_rate=0.05% overall. No user-facing incidents.
jessica: I've reviewed traces for the flagged requests — latency root cause is downstream queueing, not this release. I'm comfortable promoting to 20% across all AZs.
maya: 👍 promote to 20% and run validation
deploy-bot: Promoting canary: 5% -> 20% across prod (step)
obs-bot: 15m after promotion: p50=51ms p95=188ms error_rate=0.06%
ci-bot: post-promote smoke tests passed: 20/20
jessica: ok promote to 100% if no regressions in the next 30m
(small wait)
obs-bot: 30m steady: p50=50ms p95=190ms error_rate=0.07% — within SLO
deploy-bot: Canary PROMOTION COMPLETE for runtime-proxy -> release/2026-03-20-rtp-v2.14.3 commit=8b3f2c1
deploy-bot: final status: rollout=success duration=35m
maya: thanks team. I will pin the release in the changelog and update release notes: https://go/rel/rtp/2026-03-20
sanjay: noted. will keep an eye on weekly regression alerts
oliver: :party-parrot: congrats
